title: feat(mlkface): mid-leave face reverse holds k=1..8 on B16
science: Third PR on the empty clause (extra_clause_hops = 0). Its one load-bearing datum is the mu comparator table on B_16 — axis 6,12,16,18,20,22,24,30, face 4,8,10,12,14,16,18,20, mu FAILS at k=6 and k=7 — which attributes the face-reverse repair squarely to rho3's ridge 3->3 clause (t(6,0,0) 16 under mu vs 18 under rho3). Also t(2,2,2)=10 under mu-lambda vs 8 under mu.
